posts.title: v0.24 — Multiplayer Stability and Gameplay Improvements
posts.message: Improving multiplayer room stability when switching between apps, adjusting unique card sizing, allowing players to recall cards during their turn, and correcting round scoring so results are calculated only after a round ends.

posts.title: v0.23 — Multiplayer Gameplay and Card Improvements
posts.message: Improved multiplayer rooms so matches can begin when both players are ready. Added gameplay synchronization between connected players, refined card and sleeve sizing, corrected unique card inventory behavior, and improved dealer card randomness.

posts.title: v0.22 — Multiplayer Rooms and Online Gameplay
posts.message: Expanded multiplayer functionality with private two-player rooms, room codes, player connection status, and ready controls. Added the initial systems for synchronized online gameplay and improved multiplayer room management.

posts.title: v0.21 — Multiplayer Rooms
posts.message: Introduced the foundation for online multiplayer, including the ability to create and join private player rooms.
